@{58c6d558ff44e44ada717902|full_name}: This is a massive improvement anyway, at the moment, you can click a friend and have the unfriend button in the exact same place you clicked them. Misclicking is far too easy. :)
A confirmation when removing friends has been added in VRChat 2018.3.2!

details: Basically prevent friends who are marked as "Favorite" from being unfriended and instead have to remove them from the favorites list in order to unfriend them. This way, people won't accidentally unfriend someone important via a misclick or some other other means. Either this, or make a confirmation screen that asks the player if they're sure they want to unfriend the person
title: Prevent Accidental Unfriending in Favorites Lists
